items.markdown:
You can find cheap plus-size clothing `online and in stores through budget-friendly retailers` that offer extended sizing and steep discounts.

### Affordable Plus-Size Retailers

- **Best&Less:** This brand offers budget basics like longline tees, tanks, and culotte trousers up to size 26, with most items priced between $12 and $25. Shop the collection at [Best&Less](https://www.bestandless.com.au/womens-plus-size-clothing/).[[1]](https://www.bestandless.com.au/womens-plus-size-clothing)
- **Boohoo:** They carry over 1,000 curvy styles, including high-waisted jeans, basic tees, and wrap dresses designed for fuller figures. Browse the range at [Boohoo](https://au.boohoo.com/categories/womens-plus-size).[[1]](https://au.boohoo.com/categories/womens-plus-size)
- **PrettyLittleThing:** Their online clearance features deep discounts on plus-size dresses, co-ords, and swimwear with many pieces marked down by 60% to 80%. Check out the [PrettyLittleThing Sale](https://www.prettylittlething.com.au/categories/womens-sale-plus-size).[[1]](https://www.prettylittlething.com.au/categories/womens-sale-plus-size)
- **[Fashion Nova](https://www.fashionnova.com/products/alyssa-crew-neck-top?color=yellow&variant=39296376733820&currency=AUD):** Known for cheap plus-size bodysuits, denim, and trendy midi dresses starting around $11 to $14.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12057639492774827414,catalogid:393438609275770010,gpcid:17165319661629830650,mid:576462561885936969&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16670283232610783534,catalogid:14132129980469062681,gpcid:15683526728224410836,mid:576462884833045195&ibp=oshop)

### Tips for Shopping on a Budget

- **Filter by size and price:** Always use website filters to narrow choices directly to your size and sort from lowest to highest price.
- **Check the return policy:** Cheap clothes can sometimes have inconsistent sizing, so make sure you can easily return or exchange items.
